scope: Offline replay of the same 20 saved Luna candidates; no generation, no accuracy generalization.
root_cause: _render_relation emitted valid implicit aliases unchanged, but _relation_parts recognized only explicit AS, so reference validation rejected the actual SQL aliases.
implementation: The shared relation parser accepts implicit aliases on qualified/quoted table names and parenthesized sources. Explicit AS and trailing SQL clauses remain intact; original names hidden by aliases and duplicate bindings remain rejected.

verification.pipeline: Existing Benchmark evaluate_arm -> Compiler -> Assurance -> read-only SQLite -> frozen Gold/Contract evaluator
verification.outbound_network: Forbidden by Python audit hook; private config/credentials forbidden
